Name: The Big Garage
Author: HopeWasHere
Description:
Using a vehicle mod for your horse and the stable stands out? Would you like a garage to store that bike, scooter, or whatever else? This mod is the one for you!

Using lambui's Tractor Mod: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/gameplay-mod-tractor-mod.126955/ you can have a large garage to store your toys.

Now with seasonal Immersion!!
(http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-seasonal-immersion.125683/)

This mod goes great with Pi.Curious' Horse to Vespa Scooter Mod: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/horse-to-vespa-scooter-garage-joja-scooter-added.110212/

If you want to ride a scooter around, but still want to see cute horses around your farm, check out this mod here: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/905/?

For troubleshooting and other mods by me, check out the official discussion here: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/garages-horses-and-hair-oh-my.130359/
